text:
acme_ops: Hi team — our invoice for March 10 (inv_4621) shows ~12.1M tokens but the dashboard for org AcmeCorp says ~8.2M. Can we get help reconciling? Noticed a spike around 02:15 UTC where mobile app had lots of timeouts.

jess-billing: Sorry about that — can you paste a couple of request IDs or sample timestamps? I can start looking at ledger rows.

acme_ops: Sure — sample request_ids from our client logs: rq_aa7f3c, rq_aa7f3d, rq_bb8e2f (02:14:59 — 02:16:10 UTC). SDK log snippet:```
[02:15:01] POST /v1/streams -> timeout after 4s
[02:15:02] Retrying request (no idempotency key present)
[02:15:03] HTTP/1.1 200 OK (token_cost: 2145)
```

acme_ops: We saw the app hit a flaky cell tower, then it reconnected and the SDK retried. Dashboard shows only the successful 200 calls, but invoice seems to include both initial timed-out attempts + final success.

simon-sre: :eyes: Can you also attach the raw request headers for rq_aa7f3c? Particularly the Idempotency-Key header.

acme_ops: header dump for rq_aa7f3c:```
POST /v1/streams
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx
User-Agent: AcmeMobile/3.2
X-Request-ID: rq_aa7f3c
# No Idempotency-Key present in the original timed-out attempt
```

maria-eng: Interesting — SDK should have been adding Idempotency-Key. Which SDK version?

acme_ops: Mobile SDK 0.8.1 (Android). We just rolled that out in Feb.

mobile-sdk-bot: Noted: SDK 0.8.1 had a known issue where retries after network timeouts omitted the idempotency header when connection was torn and re-established. Patch 0.9.3 fixes this. See CHANGES: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/releases/tag/v0.9.3

jess-billing: Ok — that explains missing idempotency keys on client-side retries. But why would that cause double-billing? We dedupe on idempotency key server-side. If key missing, we might log two separate successful completions. Need to check gateway behavior: is there any path that retries on behalf of client?

simon-sre: Pulling proxy logs for that 02:14-02:16 window. Looks like our edge (old CDN-to-proxy translation) performed an internal retry on a 502 from an upstream and reissued the request without forwarding all custom headers; Idempotency-Key was dropped on the re-issue. Also saw a 302 redirect that stripped the header.

maria-eng: That combination sucks: client retry without idempotency key + edge retry that strips headers = multiple distinct requests reaching the ledger. Can you grep ledger for X-Request-ID and raw token_count? jess?

jess-billing: Running quick ledger query now for AcmeCorp around those timestamps. Example SQL (pseudo):
```sql
SELECT request_id, status, billed_tokens, timestamp FROM ledger WHERE request_id IN ('rq_aa7f3c','rq_aa7f3d','rq_bb8e2f');
```
Result:
- rq_aa7f3c | success | 2145 | 2026-03-10T02:15:03Z
- rq_aa7f3c | success | 2145 | 2026-03-10T02:15:05Z  <-- duplicate row
- rq_aa7f3d | timeout | 0 | 2026-03-10T02:15:20Z
- rq_bb8e2f | success | 2120 | 2026-03-10T02:15:58Z

jess-billing: Looks like the ledger has duplicate success rows for rq_aa7f3c. The invoice aggregator counts both.

acme_ops: So the dashboard dedupe logic hides duplicates by request_id, but invoice pipeline double-counted because it aggregates by ledger row timestamp?

simon-sre: Dashboard query uses normalized request_id + dedupe on (idempotency_key OR request_id), but invoice pipeline aggregates raw ledger events without dedupe for historical throughput. That's the gap.

maria-eng: Root causes: (1) mobile SDK omission of idempotency keys on retries (0.8.1), (2) edge retries/redirects that can strip headers, (3) invoice pipeline assumes ledger events are already deduped.

jess-billing: Impact: prelim estimate — 3 customers affected, ~40k tokens each, totalling ~120k tokens over that 2h window. I'll need precise numbers for credits.

acme_ops: We can reproduce locally: enable airplane mode for 1s then restore, force SDK retry policy. Steps:
1) Run mobile emulator w/ SDK 0.8.1
2) Send a 2k-token streaming request with idempotency disabled
3) Simulate network hiccup -> SDK retries -> observe missing Idempotency-Key on retry

maria-eng: Repro confirmed on our end when we flip the emulator network. Will produce a small failing test for CI.

simon-sre: Immediate mitigation: pin gateway config to preserve all X- headers on retries and avoid converting 302 redirects that drop headers. Rolling a config change to edge cluster in prod now. deploy-bot: started canary at 02:50 UTC.\
deploy-bot: canary deployment: preserve-idempotency-headers v1 -> 3/10 02:50 UTC. Monitoring HTTP header pass-through metrics.\
maria-eng: Short-term fix: ship mobile SDK 0.9.3 to ensure retries forward idempotency keys. Medium-term: make server-side dedupe stricter by hashing (customer_id + payload_fingerprint + idempotency_key) and extend idempotency TTL to 24h for streaming endpoints.

jess-billing: For reconciliation: I'll run a dedupe job over ledger rows for last 48 hours, grouping by (customer_id, request_id, payload_hash) and produce a corrected invoice delta. If dedupe job finds duplicates, billing will issue credits; I need sign-off from finance but we'll prioritize.

acme_ops: Appreciate it — can you scope timeline? Our customer ops needs expected time to resolution to inform stakeholders.

jess-billing: Plan:
- 02:50 UTC: edge config canary (simon)
- 03:10 UTC: if stable, full edge roll (simon)
- 06:00 UTC: mobile SDK patch release + PR to mobile app teams to pick up 0.9.3 (maria)
- 12:00 UTC: dedupe ledger run and draft credit memo for affected customers (jess)
- 18:00 UTC: postmortem + followups (owners: simon, maria, jess)

simon-sre: rolling edge fully at 03:12 — header pass-through stable in canary, no latency impact.

maria-eng: CI test added: emulate flaky connection and assert idempotency header is present on retries (will fail on 0.8.1). I'll attach link to PR when ready.

jess-billing: Running dedupe job now in dry-run mode. Early results: found duplicate success rows for 3 customers, total duplicated billed tokens = 118,920. Draft credit memos for these orgs ready for finance review.

acme_ops: Thank you. Please cc me on credits so I can confirm with our finance team.

jess-billing: Will do. Next steps: (1) finance confirms credits, (2) mobile team publishes 0.9.3 and mobile apps are urged to update, (3) we add golden-path monitoring that correlates invoice totals vs dashboard token counts daily and alerts on >5% drift.

maria-eng: Adding postmortem notes: SDK bug link + edge header fix + dedupe-run links.

acme_ops: Great — closing the loop with our CFO. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
